list.query: SELECT symbol, venue, count() AS trades, avg(price) AS avg_price FROM market.trade GROUP BY symbol, venue

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.name AS table, t.total_rows AS rows, formatReadableSize(t.total_bytes) AS size, p.last_insert AS last_insert, t.metadata_modification_time AS schema_changed FROM system.tables AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT table, max(modification_time) AS last_insert FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'market' AND active GROUP BY table) AS p ON p.table = t.name WHERE t.database = 'market' ORDER BY t.name

panels.title: Rows inserted per table

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, table, sum(rows) AS rows FROM system.part_log WHERE database = 'market' AND event_type = 'NewPart' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time, table ORDER BY time

panels.description: From system.part_log. Turn a dynamic table on or off in config/tables.yaml and watch its line start or stop.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name, type, default_expression FROM system.columns WHERE database = 'market' AND table = ${table:singlequote} ORDER BY position

panels.title: Latest rows in $table

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM market.${table} WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) ORDER BY ts_event DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: Uses ts_event, which every message in schema/market.xml starts with; the time filter lets ClickHouse skip old partitions.

panels.title: Schema changes (CREATE / ALTER)

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time, query_kind, query FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND query_kind IN ('Create', 'Alter', 'Drop') AND has(databases, 'market') AND NOT startsWith(query, 'CREATE DATABASE') AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: What persistence (or anyone) changed. A new SBE field in a dynamic table shows up here as ADD COLUMN.

panels.title: Ad-hoc SQL
panels.description: Type any query in the SQL box at the top. Grafana Explore and http://localhost:8123/play work too.
